         BAROSMA CRENULATUM

       Buchu

      (BAROSMA CRENATA)


Marked specific effects on genito-urinary system;   muco-purulent
      discharges  . Irritable bladder, with vesical catarrh; prostatic disorders. Gravel.
      Leucorrhœa.



Relationship.--  Compare: Copaiva;   Thuja;
      Populus; Chimaph  . See Diosma.



Dose.--  Tincture or tea from leaves.
